'''Bonekrusher Ballista''' is an [[Elite enemy]] in ''[[Arknights: Endfield]]''.

{{Enemy description|A Landbreaker armed with a heavy ranged weapon. Ballistas are elites selected from Ambushers who proved their worth. Their heavy bolts are capable of punching right through heavy body armor.}}

==Overview==
A Bonekrusher that wields a Ballista, the Bonekrusher Ballista is a strong foe to tackle, due to their abilities that allow them to pummel Operators easily, close or afar:

*Swings their ballista, dealing Physical damage.
*Swings their ballista twice, dealing Physical damage.
*Attacks with a shoulder charge, knocking Operators back.
*Fires one explosive shot, dealing Physical damage, followed by the explosion that deals Physical damage.
*Fires three consecutive shots, dealing Physical damage.
*Fires two arrow rains, dealing Heat damage in an area. This ability can be interrupted by skills.
**Arrows stay on the area for a short period, dealing continuous Heat damage to Operators on them.
*Leaps towards the controlled Operator and slams, dealing Physical damage. This is followed by a short charge up, afterwards leaps backwards and fires a shot in the process, dealing Physical damage. This ability can be interrupted by skills.
